Hello fellow learners...!!!

I would like to share my experience after completing the course and strongly recommend Edwin Art of Driving School for the following reasons

1. The training program is well-organized and pays attention to minute details of driving techniques.

2.Edwin classes and techniques are  significantly more effective than conventional motor driving schools, which often waste your time and money.

3.The course includes a theoretical framework explaining how a car responds in different situations before practical lessons begin.

4.Edwin team including his trainers are highly educated and skilled individuals who understand the emotional challenges faced by beginner drivers. They focus on addressing each learner's specific weaknesses and pain areas.

5. Edwin himself came to my first class upon my request despite his busy schedule, which demonstrated his commitment to the students.

6.From my first lesson on clutch control, I felt empowered and in command of the vehicle, significantly boosting my confidence.

7.The training also covers defensive driving techniques that are not commonly taught in India, helping me better understand other drivers' behaviors on the road.

8.The ability to schedule classes according to individual needs was an added benefit for me. I give this aspect a perfect score of 5/5 for their understanding and flexibility.

After completing the course, I have gained a level of confidence that I did not achieve through traditional motor driving classes. The premium fee charged is absolutely justified by the quality of training provided.

Thank you to Edwin and his team!
Wishing best of luck for his future endeavours.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Bike Riding Course - Highly Recommended!

I had a truly fantastic experience with this bike riding class! When I started, I didn't know how to ride a bike at all, and now, I’ve purchased and am confidently riding my own motorcycle. The transformation in skill and confidence is incredible.

The core of the class, particularly the intermediate traffic training, was extremely valuable. I gained practical, real-world experience that made me comfortable navigating busy roads. This instruction was instrumental in preparing me for daily commuting.

A massive thank you to Urvarshi Mam. She is exceptionally knowledgeable and her way of teaching is highly appreciated. She was helpful, patient, and truly ensured that every student grasped the necessary skills. Her expertise made all the difference.

I have only two minor pieces of constructive feedback:

I faced some difficulty with the schedule changes, as the morning class times were shifted to evening and night, which caused a small inconvenience.

The provided training bike, a Bajaj Avenger, was not self-start, meaning we often had to push it to get it going. While it taught us an old-school technique, a self-start option would definitely improve the flow of the lessons.

Despite these small logistical issues, everything else was excellent. The quality of instruction and the experience gained far exceeded my expectations. If you are looking to learn how to ride a bike confidently, this is the place to go!
